## **Core System**

- `hyprland` - Wayland compositor and window manager
- `hypridle` - Idle management daemon for Hyprland
- `hyprsunset` - Blue-light filter and screen temperature adjustment
- `pipewire` - Multimedia and audio server
- `xdg-desktop-portal` - Desktop portal framework
- `xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland` - Hyprland portal backend
- `xdg-desktop-portal-gtk` - GTK portal backend

## **Qt & Shell**

- `quickshell` - Qt/QML-based shell and widget framework
- `qt6-declarative` - Qt QML language tools (`qmlls`)
- `qt6-imageformats` - Additional image format support
- `qt6-svg` - SVG image support

## **Appearance & Fonts**

- `bibata-cursor-theme` - Bibata Modern Ice cursor theme
- `ttf-ibm-plex` - IBM Plex font family
- `ttf-ibm-plex-mono-nerd` - IBM Plex Mono with Nerd Font icons
- `google-sans-flex` - Google Sans Flex UI font
- `ttf-material-symbols-variable` - Material Symbols icon font
- `noto-fonts` - General-purpose font family and Unicode coverage
- `noto-fonts-cjk` - Noto fonts for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean (CJK) text
- `noto-fonts-emoji` - Emoji font support
- `ttf-dejavu` - General-purpose sans-serif, serif and monospace fonts
- `ttf-liberation` - Metric-compatible alternatives to Arial, Times New Roman and Courier New

## **Applications**

- `kitty` - Terminal emulator
- `zen-browser-bin` - Zen Browser
- `thunar` - File manager

## **CLI Tools**

- `fish` - Interactive shell (version 4.0 or newer)
- `starship` - Shell prompt
- `fzf` - Command-line fuzzy finder (version 0.48 or newer)
- `eza` - Modern alternative to `ls` (optional)
- `git` - Version control system
- `curl` - Data transfer utility
- `wl-clipboard` - Wayland clipboard utilities
- `cliphist` - Clipboard history manager
- `brightnessctl` - Display brightness control
- `playerctl` - Media player control
- `fuzzel` - Application launcher (temporary, until the shell provides one)

## **Neovim & Yazi**

- `neovim` - Text editor (version 0.12 or newer)
- `yazi` - Terminal file manager
- `ffmpeg` - Media preview and processing
- `7zip` - Archive extraction and compression
- `jq` - JSON processor
- `poppler` - PDF rendering and utilities
- `fd` - Fast alternative to `find`
- `ripgrep` - Fast recursive text search
- `fzf` - Command-line fuzzy finder
- `zoxide` - Smarter directory navigation
- `resvg` - SVG rendering
- `imagemagick` - Image processing and conversion
- `lua-language-server` - Lua language server
- `basedpyright` - Python language server
